text:
Sam: Quick rundown 3 mini design follow-up: we need a compact onboarding output so runtime can make routing/fallback decisions without re-running benches. ideas below.

Tanya: ok drop it in. short thread pls.

Sam: Plan A (summary signals): onboarding returns small set of tags + numeric metrics. tags: latency_ok, mem_ok, emb_ok, stable_quant, drift_warn, needs_fullbench. metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency (seq128), tok/sec throughput (batch=8), cosine_mean on golden.

Leo: nice. question: how do we avoid owners gaming the tags? e.g., tuning golden to match model.

Sam: mitigation: store golden-provenance, require at least 3 independent corpora, and surface diffs. also random holdout checks run during fullbench.

Maya: ops: canary policy needs to tie to signal tags. propose mapping: if tags contains drift_warn -> route <=5% traffic and force fullbench. if latency_ok && emb_ok -> route up to 25% with tighter SLOs. else block GA.

Tanya: agree. also need model_class-specific thresholds. embedder p95 is different than generative model.

Leo: on quantized builds: they can be green for latency/mem but yellow for emb. add allowed-delta field with L2 or cosine_thresh. runtime treats "yellow" as fallback hint.

Sam: good. interface sketch (as a stringified object stored in registry): 
```
{
  "status":"pass|warn|fail",
  "signal_tags":["latency_ok","drift_warn"],
  "metrics":{"p50":"12ms","p95":"45ms","cosine_mean":"0.912"},
  "metadata":{"model_class":"embedder","quant":"q8_0","seqlen_p90":"128"},
  "artifacts":["s3://bench/xxx/logs","s3://bench/xxx/diffs"]
}
```

Maya: ops note: fullbench is costly. recommend default path: smoke + scheduled fullbench weekly. teams can pay for expedited run (chargeback). add field "bench_ticket" for priority.

Tanya: add a 24-72h production canary after initial GA. collect user-facing metrics, and auto-rollback if key metrics degrade beyond X%.

Leo: next step: I9ll draft RFC that includes signal-tag taxonomy, API contract, bench cadence, and cost model. will include embed vs gen examples.

Sam: assign Leo. Tanya will draft thresholds per model_class. Maya will draft canary playbook and chargeback proposal. target RFC in 10 days.

ingest-bot: note: added /onboard/signal-tags RFC stub (https://internal.redwood/docs/onboard/signal-tags).

Tanya: thanks all. short and actionable.
